summary: fix(e-boekhouden): preserve mutation line-level VAT rows across sync
reason: The generated store upsert (ON CONFLICT ... DO UPDATE SET data = excluded.data) unconditionally overwrites the cached record on every write. mutation get-id caches a detail response with line-level VAT rows that the list endpoint (used by sync) omits, so a sync run after a get-id silently dropped the cached rows and zeroed VAT-summary totals. This affected both the single-record UpsertMutation path and the UpsertBatch path that sync actually uses -- the first fix only covered UpsertMutation, and Greptile re-review caught that UpsertBatch bypassed it entirely.
validated_outcome: go build ./... and go test ./... pass. Added TestUpsertBatch_PreservesMutationRowsAcrossSync, confirmed to fail without the fix and pass with it. Greptile review threads on PR #1867 resolved for both the single-record and batch-path findings.

deferred_to_upstream.feature: Generic per-resource store upsert (internal/generator/templates/store.go.tmpl) should not let a thinner list-sync write silently overwrite a richer cached detail write, for any resource type
deferred_to_upstream.reason: This patch is scoped to the mutation resource type only in e-boekhouden. The underlying pattern -- generic upsert always overwrites the full data blob -- affects every resource with a list/detail response-shape asymmetry across every printed CLI, and needs a real generator design pass (merge-preserve vs. write-provenance tracking vs. something else), not a copy of this local workaround.
